display_long_description:
# Survive and Expel Evil Spirits in Your Own Home!

Turn your house into a terrifying horror game where evil spirits will hunt you down. These spirits can navigate your physical environment, making each encounter even more immersive. With up to 14 unique spirits, each possessing different abilities and hunting styles, every experience is a new challenge.
[media]

Check out Story Mode added to Hauntify where the player can complete a variety of terrifying chapters.  Story Mode is available only when selecting the Meta Multi-Room Scan option.
[media]

# Additional New VR Mode
Play Hauntify in a virtual house full of terrifying curses!
[media]

# Important:
Make sure your doors link properly between scanned rooms, and ensure no doors lead outside of the scanned areas. Large holes in walls can cause the nav mesh to extend outside the game boundaries. Scanning environment correctly will make the experience better for you.

The nav mesh must be fully contained within your play area with no linkage to the outside.

Note: Quest 1 is not supported.

If you need help with setup or have feedback, join the Discord community via the link on the company website. This game is being developed, but your support will help it grow and improve.

Please consider leaving a review if you enjoyed the game. Reviews help motivate the creator to continue supporting the project and adding more content.

For any setup issues, feedback, or suggestions, please reach out to the creator directly through the Discord link. https://discord.gg/53d4NQnDE9
